title: Adapter Ligation with AMII
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdp9i5r6

steps.title: Prepare ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Combine 30 µL end‑repaired amplicon pools, 10 µL 5X NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer, 5 µL AMII adapter mix, and 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase to a total volume of 50 µL.

steps.title: Incubate ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the 50 µL ligation mix at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL (1:1) SPRI beads to the tube, vortex beads beforehand to obtain a homogeneous brown suspension, then mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

steps.title: Collect liquid
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge briefly to bring all liquid to the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Incubate beads
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bind beads magnetically
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes or until beads have pelleted and the supernatant is clear.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Two SFB washes
steps.instruction: Perform two washes with SFB to remove excess adapter.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL SFB, resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing (do not use 70 % ethanol).
Repeat steps 1‑2 for a second wash.
After the second wash, pulse‑centrifuge and discard any residual SFB; no air‑drying required.

steps.title: Elute library
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL EB, resuspend beads by pipette mixing.

steps.title: Incubate eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Separate beads
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack to collect beads.

steps.title: Transfer final library
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear eluate (final library) to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
